subject.title: feat: show cloud workspace conflicts in the Control UI

question: Should the Control UI make staged cloud-workspace conflict recovery a first-class operator flow with copyable inspect and take-cloud commands?
rationale: The patch adds a new durable recovery presentation and operator guidance surface; the protected `maintainer` label means this acceptance decision should remain explicit even if implementation and proof are otherwise satisfactory.

options.title: Approve the recovery UX after proof
options.body: Accept the phase-3 UI design once a redacted real conflicted-worker run demonstrates notice, dismissal, sidebar attention, and transcript persistence.

options.title: Narrow the UI surface
options.body: Keep conflict visibility but remove or redesign the copyable recovery commands if maintainers do not want shell-oriented actions in the Control UI.

recommendation.title: Approve the recovery UX after proof
recommendation.body: Accept the phase-3 UI design once a redacted real conflicted-worker run demonstrates notice, dismissal, sidebar attention, and transcript persistence.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the merged cloud-workspace conflict contract and authored the proposed Control UI completion.
